user.text: Add a custom font to the BlogHeader. Use 'Playfair Display' for the main heading and 'Roboto' for the subtitle. Add all of the fonts and logic inside BlogHeader.

history.assistant:
The BlogHeader now uses Playfair Display for the main heading and Roboto for the subtitle. All the font code is in `app/BlogHeader.tsx`.

- Both fonts are loaded with Next.js's built-in `next/font/google`, so no new packages are needed. Next.js downloads the fonts at build time and serves them from your own site.
- The heading uses Playfair Display at weight 700 and the subtitle uses Roboto at weight 400, both with `display: 'swap'` and the `latin` character set.
- Each font is applied to its element with the font's `className`, so nothing else on the page changes.

I checked it with `npx next build`, which succeeded (exit code 0) with no errors. I didn't look at the page in a browser.

Running the build also changed `tsconfig.json`: Next.js added `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` to its `include` list. You can keep that change or revert it.
